_comment: The site, as data. The Express server (app.js, server/) reads it to serve pages and redirects; tools/build-site.js reads it to rebuild the pages from pages_original/ (the patches are in site/patches/*.json); tools/check-links.js and the project overview read it too. To add or rename a page, change it here. If you export a page again from Claude Design, drop it into pages_original/ under the same name and run: npm run build:site. The Design Studio page is built from the studio's own export, swatchroom/terucon/Swatchroom.html. `docs` holds the pages that are not built from an export: the project overview and the Coming soon page (shown, with a 404 status, for any address that is no page).
name: Terucon

home.label: Terucon website
home.description: The landing page: who Terucon is, the process, the work, and the enquiry form.

materials.label: Materials
materials.description: The materials shop: sheets, stone, terracotta and finishes, priced per unit, with a saved list and a cart.

studio.label: Design Studio
studio.description: Photograph a room, tap a wall, floor or ceiling, pick a finish and see it rendered into the real photo (Swatchroom). The studio itself is the swatchroom/ app, mounted in this website.

dashboard.label: My project
dashboard.description: The client dashboard: design, decisions, quote and materials in one place (a front-end prototype with a demo project).

connections._comment: Which pages each page must link to (checked by tools/check-links.js and the browser tests). The dashboard keeps some links inside its own views, so its links are looked for in every view.

overview.label: Project overview
overview.description: What every part of the project does, with live status when the server is running.

comingSoon.label: Coming soon
comingSoon.description: Shown for any page that does not exist yet, and the page to link to for something that is still being built.
